set.name: AppIcon
set.description:
— s2a:meta —
version:    1.1.1
status:     active
updated:    2026-09-10
changelog:
  1.1.1   2026-09-10  patch        Fixed Size=48 and Size=80 (added in 1.1.0) — their nested icon layer wasn't wired to the exposed Icon instance-swap property, so switching to those sizes silently reset the icon to the default (CreativeCloud) instead of preserving the selected app mnemonic. Re-linked componentPropertyReferences to match the other 4 sizes.
  1.1.0   2026-09-08  minor        Size variant renamed from t-shirt (xs/sm/md/lg) to pixel values (16/18/24/32); added 48 and 80 to support the new Product Marquee_Grid XL lockup. Non-breaking in Figma (instances auto-relabel); code side (size prop enum, spec.json) needs a matching update.
  1.0.0   2026-08-04  init         Initial release
